group: Assistant execution, communications, phone, commerce, and Vault

group: Assistant execution, communications, phone, commerce, and Vault

group: Assistant execution, communications, phone, commerce, and Vault

group: Assistant execution, communications, phone, commerce, and Vault

group: Assistant execution, communications, phone, commerce, and Vault

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Every task-like Slack/email/message creates only a read-only Task Candidate with source, classification and confidence; it cannot create Jira or TASK, launch Forge, edit code or reply.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Exact Jira keys are re-read from the configured account before correlation; fuzzy similarity only proposes alternatives, and source edit, deletion or ambiguity invalidates receipts.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: A candidate without canonical Jira is held until Jira is linked, a create payload approved, or a policy-permitted Manual Task Intake promoted; all paths converge on the same sanitization and gates.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Each Intake publishes the Source Requirement Matrix and fallback ladder; required unavailable, stale or unauthorized sources stay distinct from verified empty and need a fallback or waiver.
required_evidence_summary: Missing Jira, NeoSapien, /quillbot-lt-conventions, triggered skill, knowledge/Graphify, repository, assistant-prompt and Forge-outage cases.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Imperative language, notification opens, classifier confidence or prior approval authorize only read-only preparation; TASK mutation needs exact pack approval and code needs later gates.
required_evidence_summary: Speech/UI/replay/stale-hash/changed-scope denials and proof of no unseen-payload or early-Build authorization.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Context Bootstrap inspects the authorized MCP registry for an official NeoSapien memory server and records vendor identity, transport, scopes, region and license; look-alikes are never official.
required_evidence_summary: Registry and handshake/capability receipt, official-document evidence or explicit unavailable/unverified state, plus name-collision and unofficial-bridge denial tests.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Once verified, work intake uses the NeoSapien MCP only through the central gateway with a task-scoped read-only grant, paginating fully and fetching content only for selected results.
required_evidence_summary: Sanitized MCP trace, query provenance, timezone/DST and pagination coverage, account/scope receipt, selected/excluded results, prompt-injection denial and zero-write assertion.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Empty search, processing, unavailable service, timeout, expired auth, denied scope and deleted item are distinct states; missing required Neo context stops TASK mutation until export or waiver.
required_evidence_summary: No-match, processing, partial-page, timeout, auth-expiry, scope-denial, edited/deleted/revoked, manual-export and waiver tests.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Meeting analysis separates transcript spans, human notes, summaries, decision states, actions, contradictions and inferences, preserves provenance and reconciles against Jira and current code.
required_evidence_summary: Cited analysis with duplicate capture, ambiguous speaker, stale/superseded decision, conflict and new-symbol re-exploration cases.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: After the approved TASK patch the full assistant-prompt.md hash is computed and the whole file delivered to the correct Forge project; Forge acknowledges every hash or fails closed.
required_evidence_summary: Sender/receiver hash equality, sentinel and marker validation, wrong-chat/repository, truncation, changed-file invalidation, reconnect and duplicate-handoff tests.

group: QuillBot work intake, NeoSapien MCP, and Forge handoff
criterion_summary: Direct Forge Ask/Explore is read-only; a QuillBot Build validates the full Intake, sealed pack, prompt hash and every receipt without self-waiver, while generic Builds use their own Intake.
required_evidence_summary: QuillBot and generic direct-chat, truncated/manual-task, wrong project, stale index, missing required source/waiver, false-not-applicable and forged-receipt denial tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: The system separates transcription adaptation, meeting-local diarization, the owner's enrolled profile and another person's consented persistent profile in architecture, storage, UI and policy.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Owner enrollment and adaptation are local-first, inspectable, versioned, benchmarked and deletable, improving held-out recognition without unacceptable false matches or regression.
required_evidence_summary: Before/after WER and speaker metrics across approved devices, noise and accents, artifact lineage, reset/delete and rollback test.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Other voices default to ephemeral meeting-local labels; persistent named recognition requires a valid Speaker Profile Consent Record, and withdrawal cascades through derived artifacts.
required_evidence_summary: Denied-without-consent, enrollment, open-set recognition, withdrawal, deletion-cascade and backup-expiry tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Continuous adaptation is an offline reviewable candidate workflow; low-quality, uncertain, sensitive, echo, replay and unconsented segments are rejected and live sessions never update weights.
required_evidence_summary: Candidate inclusion/exclusion receipts, poisoning/regression/unknown-speaker evaluation, approval and rollback evidence.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Voice identity is never sufficient authorization; uncertain, replayed, synthetic and unknown voices are rejected or labelled rather than forced into a match.
required_evidence_summary: FAR/FRR/EER/calibration, unknown-rejection, replay/synthetic/media/crosstalk tests and T2/T3 denial receipts.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: In wake-only mode untriggered audio stays only in the disclosed RAM ring buffer of at most two seconds and produces no transcript, embedding, memory, file, database write or network attempt.
required_evidence_summary: Instrumented network/filesystem/memory-boundary test across at least 10,000 non-trigger windows.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Persistent enrollment requires an OS-authenticated ceremony and purpose/retention consent; owner enrollment spans at least two sessions and three acoustic conditions and rejects poor-quality samples.
required_evidence_summary: Positive/negative enrollment tests plus sample-quality and provenance receipts.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: On frozen consented target hardware, owner-versus-other matching uses one calibrated threshold meeting the approved target of FAR under 0.1% and FRR under 5% with confidence intervals.
required_evidence_summary: Reproducible evaluation report and threshold/version artifact; metrics never market voice as authentication.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Diarization reports DER/JER, speaker-count and overlap error, p50/p95 stabilization latency, CPU/GPU/RAM, battery and thermals on target devices using public plus consented private data.
required_evidence_summary: Benchmark ADR with approved per-condition thresholds and no unsupported recognizes-everyone claim.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Owner adaptation is off by default, versioned and rollbackable; promotion cannot worsen false-match or spoof acceptance in any slice or regress false-non-match beyond one point without approval.
required_evidence_summary: Base-versus-candidate held-out/impostor/spoof comparison, raw-sample erasure proof and rollback test.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Local-only mode supports enrollment, diarization, verification, adaptation, export and deletion with network denied and telemetry off; no classifier may start retained transcription.
required_evidence_summary: Packet capture, offline end-to-end test, mode-transition denial test and one-action correction/pause evidence.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Forget/withdraw immediately disables matching, deletes local artifacts within a minute, paired devices within the published target and backups per policy; no artifact may be used for cloning.
required_evidence_summary: Complete artifact inventory, deletion receipts/pending-state UI, offline-device reconnect test and prohibited-secondary-use tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Every supplied video or Artifact is canonicalized and deduplicated; inaccessible content is marked unverified and triggers an exact official-export request rather than an invented description.
required_evidence_summary: Source manifest showing all supplied URLs, duplicate relations, access result and missing-file request.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence

required_evidence_summary: Motion/Material Evidence Matrix, asset/code/provenance scan, chronological-similarity and side-by-side originality review, A/B/C Artifact comparison and p50/p95/p99 frame/jank evidence.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: The unlock/system-check ceremony reflects real checks with distinguishable pass, degraded, blocked and unknown states; a failed source is never animated as healthy and the ceremony is skippable.
required_evidence_summary: Injected pass/fail/unknown/offline cases, source drill-down, boot-duration/skip test and audit-event comparison.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Every semantic topology edge, node, pulse and status has documented meaning resolving to real provenance; decorative particles are classified ambient and barred from implying work or health.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: The suite-wide core/face state machine has one tested mapping for all sixteen named states, exposing them through text and non-color cues without showing raw chain-of-thought.
required_evidence_summary: State snapshot/motion/earcon matrix, assistive-technology assertions, color-blind test and tool-event-to-visible-state reconciliation.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Cinematic 3D is limited to brand, wake/unlock, idle, high-level topology and major transitions; code, diffs, terminals, transcripts, approvals and errors stay calm and readable with 3D disabled.
required_evidence_summary: Representative Command/Forge/Counsel journeys at 3D on and off, 200% zoom, reduced motion/transparency and contrast/visual-regression evidence.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Prompt, component, skill, model and visual-template galleries display source, license, version, compatibility, data egress, cost and install scope; a reel badge is never treated as license proof.
required_evidence_summary: Provenance/SBOM/license records, blocked-unknown-license test and preview-versus-install approval evidence.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Every approved hardware/OS/browser/resolution/quality row defines and meets numeric p95/p99 frame time, jank, long-task, input-latency, power and thermal limits with compositor headroom reserved.
required_evidence_summary: p50/p95/p99 frame, jank and long-task distributions, input latency, headroom calculation, GPU/CPU/RAM/battery/thermal-soak traces; suspension, WebGL-context-loss and no-WebGL end-to-end tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Command and Forge show a truthful priority-ordered resume state naming what waits and why, with repo, agent, action trace, pending approval and exact resume/cancel/rollback choices.
required_evidence_summary: Forced interruption/restart/offline/handoff scenarios, event-log reconciliation, checkpoint restoration and stale-approval invalidation.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Desktop/ultrawide, phone and optional secondary screens have documented complementary roles rather than duplicated decorative HUDs, and handoff never leaks secrets to the wrong display.
required_evidence_summary: Cross-device role matrix, phone voice/approval journey, lock-screen/privacy masking, revocation and handoff continuity tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: The source video and every derived frame, contact sheet, OCR, embedding, ledger and annotation stay private, excluded from repos, demos, marketing and training, and expire on policy.
required_evidence_summary: Artifact inventory, ACL/access log, repository/training-corpus negative scan, expiry job and deletion receipts.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Desktop-monitor footage is not evidence for mobile behavior, accessibility, gesture or voice causality, real-time 3D, secure unlock or production performance; each claim needs research.
required_evidence_summary: Claim-to-evidence matrix with separate mobile, accessibility, input-causality, security and performance tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Full-screen flashes, uncontrolled parallax, focus loss during graph morphs, color-only state and transparent text over motion are rejected; reduced modes preserve order, focus and 2D function.
required_evidence_summary: Flash-threshold/photosensitivity, vestibular, focus-order, screen-reader/live-region, contrast, 200% zoom and reduced-mode journey tests.

group: Voice identity, adaptation, and video-design evidence
criterion_summary: Every accessible supplied video produces a timestamped Feature Observation Ledger marking each capability observed, claimed, inferred, unclear or not auditable and mapping it to a disposition.
required_evidence_summary: Audio/caption transcript or explicit unaudited boundary plus frame/range links, zero-unaccounted-feature assertion, requirement-ledger diff, safe-disposition entries and implemented evidence.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Gate 2 needs per-compilation ledgers with one row per decoded frame, monotonic PTS, duplicate classification, cut/motion metrics and review status; automated decode alone is not semantic analysis.
required_evidence_summary: Separate 9,530- and 8,065-row ledgers; per-source zero-gap and exactly-once assertions, tool versions, transition indexes, reviewer sign-off, zero unresolved intervals and audio status.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: The Reference Transformation and Morphological Matrix covers every supplied clip and accepted reference from observed principle through transformation to destination and originality risk.
required_evidence_summary: Machine-checked zero-unmapped reference report with timestamped evidence and decisions.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: A/B/C are deliberate original permutations with identical feature coverage testing the Cinematic Instrument, Spatial Observatory and Obsidian Foundry hypotheses under one token/state/motion family.
required_evidence_summary: Same-scenario interactive Artifact comparison, transformation rationale, independent screen-level originality/trade-dress review and owner-selected Artifact IDs, versions and hashes.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Before A/B/C are finalized, a private Design Divergence Lab Artifact holds at least nine meaningfully different seeds across permuted axes, each with hypothesis and decision; exactly three advance.
required_evidence_summary: Versioned Divergence Lab Artifact, morphological combination matrix, seed-to-final lineage, rejected-concept log, coverage check, cosmetic-variant rejection test and independent originality review.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: The selected direction is first proven as a coherent Windows pilot experience across tray, palette, HUD, Command, Forge, Counsel, ceremony, notifications, Snap/multidisplay and window restoration.
required_evidence_summary: Windows interactive Artifact plus native pilot review at approved display sizes; keyboard/touch/Narrator/UIA, high-contrast/reduced-motion, lock/UAC/focus and resource tests.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Gate 2 also proves the direction as a coherent Mac design contract across menu bar, palette, HUD, Command, Forge, Counsel, ceremony, native sheets, Spaces/Stage Manager and multi-display behavior.
required_evidence_summary: Interactive Mac Artifact journeys at approved dimensions; minimum and latest macOS plus Apple-Silicon target matrix; later native review with no inherited Windows pass.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: A passive HUD or Counsel overlay never steals typing, selection or IME state; explicit activation announces focus transition and dismissal restores the prior app, window and insertion point.
required_evidence_summary: Focus/IME/Spaces/fullscreen/multidisplay automation plus accessibility report and unsupported-state disclosures.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: GlassMaterialAdapter uses version-gated public macOS material APIs, supported older fallback, platform-appropriate Windows treatment and accessible 2D fallbacks without imitating Apple material.
required_evidence_summary: Platform/OS availability matrix, fallback screenshots/Artifacts, API/provenance review and semantic token conformance tests.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Gate 2 includes a Cross-Platform Surface Matrix where every released platform gives a capability-appropriate primary journey for all three products; no released core product is a notification shell.
required_evidence_summary: Gate-2 adaptation panels plus per-release interactive Artifact, native-platform review, keyboard/touch/screen-reader tests, product x platform journey evidence and capability-matrix conformance.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Settled, hidden, idle and static surfaces stop continuous rendering; active 2D/3D meets measured frame, input, CPU/GPU, power and thermal budgets on Windows then independently on Apple Silicon.
required_evidence_summary: Per-platform energy/GPU/frame/jank/long-task traces across idle, streaming, active-2D and cinematic-3D; sleep/wake, low-power, thermal, context-loss and fallback tests with no cross-platform reuse.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: No production code, scaffold, dependency install, migration or repo creation begins until the exact final interactive Artifact versions for all three apps are approved; change invalidates it.
required_evidence_summary: Unchanged-worktree/dependency/infra proof and first implementation change linked to owner-approved Artifact IDs, versions and hashes.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Claude Artifacts are used only for supported static client-side synthetic prototypes within size limits and never claim a backend, auth, durable state or production integration.
required_evidence_summary: Current official capability receipt, Artifact network/storage/auth negative tests, size test, connector-only live-data proof, local-fallback parity matrix and owner waiver.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: The root Orchestrator has one original Strategic Cortex grammar at menu-bar, HUD and Command scales driven only by real events, with every pulse opening a timestamped source receipt.
required_evidence_summary: Interactive Artifact and runtime event-to-visual contract tests, fabricated-activity negative test, graph/list reconciliation, keyboard/screen-reader traversal and degraded-source states.

group: Design synthesis, macOS, and Artifact gate
criterion_summary: Gate 2 presents original Abstract Cortex, name-neutral Classical Strategist and Pure Instrument wake studies as selectable options; the chosen ceremony is optional, skippable and post-auth.
required_evidence_summary: A/B/C interactive studies, clean-room originality review, name-on/name-off variants, locked/unlocked/failure/skip/focus tests, accessibility variants and measured duration/energy evidence.

criterion_summary: A repository task cannot leave Context state until its receipt identifies repo, worktree, branch, HEAD, index coverage, relevant symbols, rules, loaded skills, Graphify evidence and omissions.
required_evidence_summary: Receipt plus tests proving stale HEAD, rules, skill or index invalidates it and false not-applicable knowledge/Graphify is denied.

criterion_summary: Within a valid scope record and before any QuillBot-specific memory, retrieval, training, exploration, LLD or planning work, Forge fully loads /quillbot-lt-conventions and triggered skills.
required_evidence_summary: Skill invocation/version/hash log, precedence report, memory/retrieval/training design receipt and missing/stale-skill blocking tests.

criterion_summary: Before Forge launches a new QuillBot task the Work Context Assembler searches NeoSapien evidence through the governed MCP path and shows included, excluded, stale and unavailable items.
required_evidence_summary: Timezone/DST boundary, relevance/deduplication, no-result versus unavailable, processing/partial, pagination, manual-export/waiver and sealed-receipt tests plus generic not-applicable tests.

criterion_summary: For a QuillBot task, Jira authority, current code, Graphify and selected meeting evidence become a reconciled cited Context Pack before any TASK diff; only TASK changes after approval.
required_evidence_summary: QuillBot ordered receipt, byte-identical outside-marker comparison, exact diff, backup/restore, sender/receiver hash equality, wrong-project/truncation denial plus a generic-project journey.

criterion_summary: Every slice follows Explore, LLD Artifact, UI Design Artifact where applicable, Plan Mode, approvals, Build then Review/QA, with no code, dependency or external write before approval.
required_evidence_summary: Unchanged-worktree pre-gate proof plus approved Artifact/node/version/hash linked to the first implementation change.

criterion_summary: Forge works through standalone desktop, terminal/TUI, IDE, web/Command and headless/SDK clients with chats, resume, model/harness selection, worktrees, multi-repository projects, DAGs and MCP.
required_evidence_summary: Contract-equivalent task run through at least two clients with the same canonical session and artifacts.

criterion_summary: Ask/Explore/Plan/Build/Review/Debug/QA modes, IDE next-edit completion, Review Workbench, evidence-first Debug, reproducible environments, checkpoints and Live Preview meet stated behavior.
required_evidence_summary: One bug reproduced, diagnosed, minimally fixed, reviewed, browser-tested, CI-tested and restored from each supported checkpoint layer, plus completion latency and leakage evaluation.

criterion_summary: Completion requires minimal diffs, relevant tests, browser QA where applicable, security/license checks, classified CI results, bounded retries and a human review packet, with action tiers preserved.
required_evidence_summary: Review packet containing plan, diff, tests, screenshots/traces, CI, risks, receipts and known limitations.

criterion_summary: Multi-agent work uses isolated worktrees, leases and typed cited handoffs; agents cannot silently share credentials or context, change scope, approve themselves or keep running after cancellation.
required_evidence_summary: Parallel-worker isolation, stale lease, prompt-injection, cancellation and conflicting-edit tests.

criterion_summary: The Host/Client Capability Matrix truthfully covers the Windows pilot first, the post-gate macOS reference and every client, naming where each privileged capability runs and what degrades.
required_evidence_summary: Matrix-to-runtime conformance tests on each released client, unsupported-capability denial, web/phone-to-paired handoff, offline/reconnect, exactly-one-executor and contract-version evidence.

criterion_summary: Command's Model/Evaluation Lab runs a governed proposal, rights review, versioned baseline, dataset card, local adapter experiment, held-out comparison, promotion decision and rollback path.
required_evidence_summary: Base-vs-retrieval-vs-adapter benchmark, dataset/model cards, source lineage and revocation drill, contamination/canary extraction suite, hardware/energy report and rollback to prior policy.

criterion_summary: Sarah can raise a cited design defect through the internal Agent Coordination Channel and a developer worker can reproduce and propose a minimal fix while both keep isolated worktrees and scopes.
required_evidence_summary: Synthetic Sarah-to-developer journey with cited design node, accepted/rejected escalation, missing-context request, isolated worktrees, cancellation, no-external-post assertion and lineage receipt.

criterion_summary: A supported IDE opens the exact workspace, worktree, file and symbol and preserves dirty buffers, encoding, line endings, selection and newer disk state while using reviewed adapters.
required_evidence_summary: VS Code-compatible plus one approved native or alternate IDE journey, dirty-buffer/concurrent-edit conflict, semantic-rename preview and debugger-expression risk tests.

criterion_summary: Forge records repo, worktree, HEAD, branch, remote and full dirty state before mutation, preserves tracked, staged, untracked, ignored and concurrent work, and never hides history rewrites.
required_evidence_summary: Dirty-tree matrix, concurrent editor, branch/worktree switch, rebase/cherry-pick/revert/bisect/conflict, crash/reconnect, byte preservation, signing and force-push denial.

criterion_summary: Forge derives repo-authoritative runtimes, package manager, lockfile, build and test commands, reviews dependency and script changes, and cannot weaken tests or coverage merely to pass.
required_evidence_summary: Multi-language fixture with package-manager mismatch, malicious install script, typosquat, unsigned binary, unexpected network access, lockfile change, flake and test-deletion denial.

criterion_summary: Browser QA produces a replayable clean-profile proof bundle covering DOM/CSS/accessibility, console/network, storage, responsive and cross-browser behavior plus declared extension surfaces.
required_evidence_summary: Chrome/Safari/Firefox capability matrix and only applicable extension install/update/uninstall, background, content-script, popup, options and side-panel journeys, redaction and env hashes.

criterion_summary: API tooling resolves the exact schema, protocol, endpoint, environment and account, shows the complete redacted request, and tests auth, TLS, CORS, pagination, limits, retries and replay.
required_evidence_summary: Protocol fixtures, wrong environment/account, changed payload, secret/redaction, duplicate side effect, certificate/proxy and contract-regression tests.

criterion_summary: Database, cache, search, queue and object-store inspection is bounded, least-privilege and redacted; destructive plans state resources, estimates, backups, rollback limits and verification.
required_evidence_summary: Local/test positive cases plus production write, destructive DDL, PII export, stale backup, queue redrive and wrong-environment denials.

criterion_summary: Every container, VM, cloud, Kubernetes and IaC operation resolves exact provider, account, region and namespace and inspects resolved configuration, privileges, secrets and digests first.
required_evidence_summary: Rootless container/Compose fixture, malicious include/mount, wrong cloud/kube context, loopback port-forward, Helm/Kustomize/IaC plan, secret scan and production-mutation gate.

criterion_summary: Forge inspects the exact pipeline commit, DAG, logs and artifacts, classifies causal failure versus flake before a bounded retry, and binds approval to provider, ref, job and variables.
required_evidence_summary: Deterministic/flaky/infrastructure/downstream fixtures, changed-ref/variable denial, artifact quarantine and local-equivalent comparison.

criterion_summary: Debugging and incident analysis correlate commit, release, flag, logs, metrics, traces, profiles and authorized session evidence into fact, hypothesis, check and conclusion with source and timezone.
required_evidence_summary: Fault-injected browser/service/Mac journey, Sentry/OpenTelemetry-style correlation, profile/trace evidence, cleanup and secret/customer-data redaction tests.

criterion_summary: Security review reconciles secret, SAST, DAST, dependency, container, IaC, license, SBOM, signature and provenance findings by version, reachability and exposure, then verifies minimal remediation.
required_evidence_summary: Seeded true/false findings, vulnerable dependency path, prompt-injection boundary, SBOM/provenance and unauthorized-scan or exploitation denial.

criterion_summary: A release packet contains exact version, changelog, commits, tests, CI, signed artifacts, SBOM, flags, rollout checks, owners and tested rollback; publication needs T2/T3 approval.
required_evidence_summary: Staging/canary fixture, changed artifact/signature invalidation, failed health check, rollback and post-deploy verification.

criterion_summary: An alert starts a deduplicated read-only Incident Intake, resolves exact service, environment and deployment and drafts mitigation, but cannot acknowledge, remediate or resolve itself.
required_evidence_summary: Duplicate/stale/wrong-service alert, runbook failure, approval expiry, handoff, rollback and independently verified recovery tests.

criterion_summary: The senior-engineer corpus covers onboarding through documentation across every named engineering family, each journey explicitly shipped, degraded, takeover, roadmap or unsupported.
required_evidence_summary: At least one full synthetic day plus positive, denied, interrupted, crash/reconnect and recovery variants for every shipped family, one canonical task ID and audit reconciliation.

criterion_summary: Counsel completes a meeting workflow with Command stopped, then submits a reviewed meeting-context proposal to the canonical Assembler; it cannot seal a pack, patch TASK or hand off to Forge.
required_evidence_summary: Standalone meeting demo, proposal receipt and proof that only the Assembler can produce the later TASK candidate.

criterion_summary: Counsel distinguishes direct assistant speech, dictation, human conversation, meeting mode, the user, other speakers, media and assistant echo; ordinary meeting speech never becomes an OS command.
required_evidence_summary: Accent, crosstalk, interruption, media, wrong-speaker, false-trigger and mode-correction evaluations.

criterion_summary: Personal Overlay supplies compact and expanded controls plus supported self-capture exclusion but never claims undetectability; preflight shows what others may see and fails closed where unverified.
required_evidence_summary: Versioned Zoom/Meet/Teams/Webex/Slack matrix, share/recording preview, multi-display test and unsupported-case warning.

criterion_summary: Mandatory preflight verifies sources, levels, transcript, overlay visibility, provider egress, retention, policy and per-participant consent before capture; withdrawals take effect at once.
required_evidence_summary: Positive/denied/withdrawal/late-join/source-change tests and consent-ledger evidence.

criterion_summary: Assist-only retain-nothing leaves no persistent audio, transcript, screenshot, embedding, summary, memory, analytics payload, backup or training example beyond the disclosed minimal audit residue.
required_evidence_summary: Post-session filesystem, database, vector, cache and backup inspection.

criterion_summary: Live suggestions prioritize other-speaker questions and give a short say-this, key points, citations, source age, confidence and verified/inference state without auto-speaking or sending.
required_evidence_summary: p50/p95 latency, WER/diarization, churn, missed-question, wrong-speaker, citation precision, factuality and stale-source evaluation.

criterion_summary: Visual context is explicitly selected, previewed, redacted, timestamped, cited and deletable; unrelated screens, notifications, password fields and private chats are not captured by default.
required_evidence_summary: Window/slide/manual-screenshot selection, provider-egress, deletion and leakage tests.

criterion_summary: Human notes stay separate and byte-preserved, the source transcript is append-only, corrections and AI notes are versioned overlays, and decisions/actions carry explicit lifecycle states.
required_evidence_summary: Lineage/hashes, crash recovery, correction, note-preservation and lifecycle-transition tests.

criterion_summary: Consent-scoped recurring timelines, Answer Cards, summaries and meeting-context proposals show provenance, freshness, ACL and review; no unreviewed answer becomes memory or training data.
required_evidence_summary: Recurring-meeting demo with conflicts, expiry, owner acceptance, Assembler lineage and rejected-learning test.

criterion_summary: Sharing or sending always shows exact recipients, account, domains, content, time range, redactions, permissions, expiry and revoke path and requires T2 approval; Counsel's MCP stays read-only.
required_evidence_summary: Send-preview/changed-payload denial and positive/negative MCP authorization receipts.
